title: CareAssure Grace, Notice and Reinstatement Periods — Service Center Reference
content:
### Asset-Based Long-Term Care Life Insurance: periods that govern unpaid ten-pay premiums

For every Ashgrove CareAssure tier of Asset-Based Long-Term Care Life Insurance, this reference card lists the grace period counted from an unpaid installment's due date, the third-party notice period counted from the mailing of a lapse notice, the number of policy years of paid premiums that earns the shortened benefit period on lapse, the reinstatement period after a lapse caused by cognitive impairment or loss of functional capacity, and whether ten-pay premiums falling due while benefits are being paid are waived.

| Tier | Grace period | Third-party notice period | Premiums paid for at least, to earn the shortened benefit period | Reinstatement period after an unintentional lapse | Premium waiver while benefits are paid |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ashgrove CareAssure 2-Year | 61 calendar days | 30 calendar days | 3 policy years | 5 calendar months | Yes |
| Ashgrove CareAssure 3-Year | 61 calendar days | 30 calendar days | 3 policy years | 5 calendar months | Yes |
| Ashgrove CareAssure 4-Year | 61 calendar days | 30 calendar days | 3 policy years | 5 calendar months | Yes |
| Ashgrove CareAssure 5-Year | 61 calendar days | 30 calendar days | 3 policy years | 5 calendar months | Yes |
| Ashgrove CareAssure 6-Year | 61 calendar days | 30 calendar days | 3 policy years | 5 calendar months | Yes |
| Ashgrove CareAssure Lifetime | 61 calendar days | 30 calendar days | 3 policy years | 5 calendar months | Yes |

**What each period is measured from**

- Grace period — 61 calendar days from the unpaid installment's due date.
- Third-party notice period — 30 calendar days after the lapse notice is mailed to the owner and the designated third party; the policy may not lapse before it ends.
- Shortened benefit period — earned on lapse where premiums were paid for at least 3 policy years; premiums paid for 2 policy years do not earn it.
- Unintentional lapse reinstatement period — 5 calendar months after lapse.
- Premium waiver — applies in every tier.

**Card example (hypothetical dates).** An installment due on 10 March 2026 and left unpaid has 61 calendar days of grace, ending on 10 May 2026. A lapse notice mailed on 1 May 2026 has a notice period ending 30 calendar days later, on 31 May 2026.
